jurisdiction_flags: Italy (TUF): mandatory bid at 30% (25% for non-SME issuers when no larger holder; SMEs may set 25-40% in by-laws); sell-out obligation above 90% (art. 108) unless float is restored; squeeze-out right at 95% (art. 111). EGM by-laws replicate these thresholds contractually (30% OPA; 90%/95% sell-out/squeeze-out). Loyalty (double) voting shares are common (GPI, Equita, WIIT) so capital and voting percentages diverge. Banks/SIMs/insurers need Bank of Italy/ECB or IVASS change-of-control clearance; Golden Power screening applies to cyber/defence software (Cy4gate) and can be invoked for healthcare and critical IT.
challenges_to_assignment: The Italian pool in Corsair's verticals is thin and shrinking: the four most obvious digital-trust/IT names (Tinexta, Digital Value, Almawave, Relatech) and the obvious HR-services name (Openjobmetis) have all been taken private since Dec 2024, and the financial-services names left in band are either banks (context only) or carry EVs above the band because of acquisition debt (GPI, doValue, WIIT). Listed Italian payments companies in band: none found (Nexi EUR 5.5bn; VNE is a tiny EGM hardware name). Listed insurance brokers in band: none (Yolo EUR 5m; Health Italia delisted Mar 2026). HR/finance software: none listed of size (Zucchetti, TeamSystem private). Expect precedent premiums of 25-40% (Almawave 37%, Tinexta/Digital Value negotiated with blockholders) and controlling founders/families as the gating item in almost every case.
